These weekly tools make practice visible and help you notice patterns over time.

## Weekly Goal

Choose one small, meaningful target for each day.

### Monday

- Goal:
- Skill I will practise:
- Strength I can use:
- What happened:

### Tuesday

- Goal:
- Skill I will practise:
- Strength I can use:
- What happened:

### Wednesday

- Goal:
- Skill I will practise:
- Strength I can use:
- What happened:

### Thursday

- Goal:
- Skill I will practise:
- Strength I can use:
- What happened:

### Friday

- Goal:
- Skill I will practise:
- Strength I can use:
- What happened:

### Saturday

- Goal:
- Skill I will practise:
- Strength I can use:
- What happened:

### Sunday

- Goal:
- Skill I will practise:
- Strength I can use:
- What happened:

## Skills and Strengths

Record the skill you practised and the strength you used.

At the end of the week, note what helped, what got in the way, and one adjustment for the next week. Missing a day is information, not failure.
